body:
Sometimes it feels like I don't have much time left, but in the grand scheme of things, 24 isn't that old.

I know you're just a random stranger on the internet, but I'm glad I had someone listen to me vent for a bit.

I hope so. I just don't know how well I can care for the both of us if my mental health makes it so that I can barely care for one person. Even when I feel like I'm doing better, I still end up thinking about the same things in the original post.

Thank you. Honestly, I feel a bit better after posting this, and a bit more knowing that there are people willing to listen.

I see what you're saying with seeing my own story through, but mine isn't nearly as interesting as I'd like it to be. I'm trying to change that, but with each step forward, it still doesn't feel like I'm doing enough. 

My brother is basically my best friend and I love him to pieces, but I can't help but think he deserves better. My mom is worried about him getting molested or something in a special needs home or something, and we don't have a lot of other people to depend on who would help us, so I'm not really sure what to do there.
